title: Valid Parentheses
hints: Which opening bracket must a closing bracket match: the first one, or the most recent unmatched one?
Push each opening bracket onto a stack. On a closing bracket, the stack must be non-empty and its top must be the matching opener. At the end the stack must be empty.
A browser's Back button works the same way: the page you return to is always the most recent one you have not already gone back from.
